extracted.name: Peach Smoothie
extracted.description: This easy peach smoothie recipe combines canned peaches, plain yogurt, bananas, and orange juice to create a smooth and delicious drink in just minutes.
ingredient_lines: 0.25 cup white sugar, or to taste
instruction_lines: Combine peaches, bananas, yogurt, orange juice, sugar, and ice in a blender; blend on high speed until ice is crushed and smoothie reaches desired consistency.
